name: Allowance
description: Remote MCP that lets agents request a user's iPhone approval for a purchase, then get a capped, merchant-locked one-time card to check out. Works in ChatGPT and Claude. Backed by Y Combinator.

skills.name: Request Purchase Approval
skills.description: Sends the user an iPhone approval request for a specific purchase intent, merchant and amount before the agent can pay.

skills.name: Issue One-Time Card
skills.description: Issues a scoped, merchant-locked virtual card capped at the approved amount, shown only through a short-lived reveal link.

skills.name: Complete Checkout
skills.description: Gets checkout context, handles card authorization and reports the purchase result and receipt back to Allowance.

skills.name: Manage Allowances
skills.description: Lists and manages the user's active allowances, the spending permissions an agent holds for a task.
